pages.title: Ostrów Wielkopolski
pages.description: city in Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
pages.extract: Ostrow Wielkopolski is a city in Wielkopolskie Voivodship, in Poland. It is in the southern part of Wielkopolska, one of the largest and the best economically developed regions of Poland. The town has around 73,000 inhabitants (2014) and is the fifth largest agglomeration in that region.

pages.title: Highway 1 (Australia)
pages.description: network of highways that circumnavigate Australia
pages.extract: Highway 1 of Australia is with a length of 14,500 km (9,000 mi), the longest national highway in the world. It can be considered a giant "ring road" as it, except for a few shortcuts, follows the entire coastline of mainland Australia. Part of the road also traverses Tasmania.

pages.title: Bad Muskau
pages.description: municipality of Germany
pages.extract: Bad Muskau is a spa town in northeastern Saxony, Germany, on the border with Poland. It is known for its palace and extensive landscape gardens that are a UNESCO World Heritage site.

pages.title: Brussels/Sonian Forest
pages.description: forest southeast of Brussels, Belgium
pages.extract: The Sonian Forest to the southeast of Brussels is a vast area of pristine nature dominated by beech and oak trees. It is a paradise for outdoor activities, and a much-needed leisure area where citizens of the crowded city can relax and regain their breath. The forest hides numerous attractions worth discovering, including some of the oldest archaeological remains in Belgium, and is protected as a  UNESCO World Heritage Site. To the northwest, the forest stretches into the city as the Ter Kameren Park, much of which is of artificial nature.

pages.title: Crown Point (Trinidad and Tobago)
pages.description: human settlement
pages.extract: Crown Point is the home of Tobago's only airport and is part of Trinidad and Tobago, a Caribbean country. For many it is the first port of call for a trip to Tobago.

pages.title: Lydford

pages.extract: Lydford is a village in Dartmoor, the English county of Devon. The village sits within Dartmoor National Park.

pages.title: Orana
pages.description: Region in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract:
The Orana region is a large rural region in north-central New South Wales.

Southern, and most of the eastern area is covered under Central West (New South Wales)
Some of the far eastern areas such as Moree (New South Wales) is covered under the New England (New South Wales) region
The northern and western areas are under Northwestern NSW

pages.title: Universal Studios
pages.description: American film and distribution company
pages.extract: Universal Pictures operates several theme park resorts around the world, generally under the brand Universal Studios. It is one of the largest corporations in mass media and entertainment, and also owns DreamWorks Animation, one of the world's largest animation companies.

pages.title: Eaglehawk Neck
pages.description: locality in Tasmania, Australia
pages.extract: Teralina / Eaglehawk Neck is the narrow strip of land that marked the northern border of the Port Arthur convict site on the Tasman Peninsula. The 30-meter narrow strip was guarded by dogs to prevent convicts from escaping during the early 19th century – this line is now called The Dog Line, and there is a small museum explaining the historical significance of this narrow strip.

pages.title: Okura
pages.description: village in Mogami District, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan
pages.extract: Okura (大蔵村 Ōkura-mura), sometimes written Ohkura, is a village in Yamagata Prefecture, Japan designated as one of the "Most Beautiful Villages in Japan". It's most known for Hijiori Onsen and Hijiori kokeshi.
